newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates ease a shade to 20.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates ease a shade to 20.125 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates eased slightly on Wednesday as customers completed social security contribution and general sales tax payments due around July 20.
Rates opened at Tuesday's levels of 20.125/20.375 percent but had eased to 20.125 by the close.
"There were some of the same big players in the market as yesterday but all trades were at a slightly lower level," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank.
Gabor Liener of Unicbank said he expected trade to be low-key from now on. "It's boring and slow and I don't see much change," he said.
